### A Real, Interpreted Language

1. By a Browser
2. By node.js, etc
3. And, most importantly, by both

---

Whatever you can copy and paste and have it work equally well whether into a
browser console or a node REPL.

---

### Framework1Script

```js
import Logo from "./logo.png";
import "./styles.css";
import Greeter from "./greeter";

function HelloWorld() {
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-screen">
      <img src={Logo} alt="Logo" className="logo" />
      <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-blue-600">
        <Greeter name="World" />
      </h1>
    </div>
  );
}
```

---

### Framework2Script

```js
import config from "./config.json";

function greet(name: string = "World"): string {
  const greeting: string = config.defaultGreeting || "Hello";
  const message: string = `${greeting}, ${name}!`;
  return message;
}
```

---

### JavaScript (with Types)

```js
import Config from "./config.js";

/**
 * @param {String} [name]
 * @returns String
 */
function greet(name = "World") {
  let greeting = Config.defaultGreeting || "Hello";
  let message = `${greeting}, ${name}!`;
  return message;
}
```

---

### NOT JavaScript, NOT ESM

```js
import "./foo";
import "./style.css";
import "./data.json";
```

---

ESM is for _JavaScript_

---

# Module

1. use code from another file
2. use code from another package (namespaced)
3. as JavaScript

---

## 1. Local Files

---

`customer.js`

```js
var User = {};
User.create = function () {};
```

`employee.js`:

```js
var User = {};
User.create = function () {};
```

`main.js`

```js
import Customer from "./customer.js";
import Employee from "./employee.js";

// do stuff ...
```

---

### TL;DW: export

```js
let User = {};

// ...

export default User;
export let create = User.create;
export let get = User.get;
```

---

### TL;DW: import

```js
// default
import Employee from "./employee.js";
```

```js
// explicit
import * as Employee from "./employee.js";
```

---

### TL;DW: require

```js
// default (counterintuitive)
let Employee = require("./employee.js").default;
```

```js
// explicit
let Employee = require("./employee.js");
```

<small><a href="https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.12.0">https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.12.0</a> (Dec, 2024)</small>

### Package Paths & Namespaces

- Browsers: index.html
- Runtimes: package.json
- Tooling: jsconfig.json

<small>(runtime entry points)</small>

---

#### Semantics

`index.html`

```html
<form method="dialog" onsubmit="FooUI.submit(window.event);">...</form>

<script type="importmap">
  {
    "imports": {
      "foo": "./foo.js",
      "foo/": "./lib/",
      "bar": "./node_modules/bar/index.js"
    }
  }
</script>

<script type="module">
  import FooUI from "foo/ui.js";
  window.FooUI = FooUI;
</script>
```

<small>WHATWG: <a href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#import-map">https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#import-map</a></small>

---

##### package.json

<br>

```json
{
  "name": "foo",
  "type": "module",
  "imports": {
    "foo": "./foo.js",
    "foo/": "./lib/",
    "baz": "./vendor/baz.js"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./foo.js",
    "./*": "./lib/*"
  }
}
```

<small><a href="https://nodejs.org/api/packages.html#package-entry-points">https://nodejs.org/api/packages.html#package-entry-points</a></small>

---

##### package.json (bonus)

<br>

#### `__dirname`, `__filename`

```js
import Path from "node:path";

let modulePath = import.meta.url.slice("file://".length);
let moduleDir = Path.dirname(modulePath);
```

---

##### jsconfig.json

```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "es2022",
    "module": "nodenext",
    "moduleResolution": "nodenext",
    "paths": {
      "foo/*": ["./lib/*"],
      "foo": ["./foo.js"],
      "baz": ["./vendor/baz.js"]
    }
}
```

<small><a href="https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig/#paths">https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig/#paths</a></small> <br>
<small><a href="https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/modules/reference.html#paths">https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/modules/reference.html#paths</a></small>

## FUD

---

The rumors...

- top-level await
- stuttering trees shake HARDER
- async module loading
- ALL-THE-CONFERENCE-SLIDES!

---

### Top-Level Await

```js
# ⚠️ not for published packages
await fetch();
```

```js
Foobar.init = async function () {
  await fetch();
};
```

---

### Tree Shake Stuttering

```js
// ❌ stuttering doesn't shake harder
import { createFoo, getFoo } from "./stuttering-foo.js";
```

```sh
# ✅ easy-to-search
grep -r -F 'Foo.'
```

---

```js
// default
import Employee from "./employee.js";
```

```js
// explicit
let Employee = require("./employee.js");
```
